text: This candidate received a low overall fit score of 0.1193 for the Senior C++ Engineer position. Their strongest evidence includes experience where they "Built REST APIs" and listed "AWS" and "Machine Learning". Key gaps include a lack of experience with C++, Boost, Linux, and various database technologies, as well as having only 1.54 years of experience. This application was escalated for manual review due to a location mismatch, missing must-have requirements, and a low overall fit.
